title.narrative: Support to Niger Supreme Audit Institution (SAI)

description.narrative: The objective of the Institutionl Development Fund is to strengthen the capacity of the Supreme Audit Institution(SAI) in Niger with a view of accelerating its modernization improving governance and transparency in the use of public funds. Strengthening the capacity of the SAI will help to better discharge its jurisdicational function and enhance its impact with regard to independent assurances on public financial management for improving transparency in the use of public funds.In addition, the SAI will be better equiped to implement the new rules introduced by the West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU) including result-based management. Its fundamental objective is to promote and ensure good govervance particularly in public finance. Primarily, the SAI has jurisdiction over all public financial reporting and has the responsibility of reviewing and verifying public income and expenditure from the Directorate of Treasury and Public Accounts, the local governments and the state owned enterprises. There is currently a backlog in the review and audits of these accounts. With this grant the capacity of the SAI will be enhanced through a twinning program that will entail joint review sessions of the SAI staff and a consultant. In the end training and reference materials will be prepared and adopted for use by the current and new staff joining the SAI. Moreover, it is pertinent that the SAI develops a medium term (3-5 years) strategic plan in which it will outline programs and activitiethat will enable it move forward on progressively clearing the existing backlog, prevent the build-up of any new backlog and develop the staff training strategy as well as a communication strategy. The communication strategy will enable the SAI create awareness to the public about its role in promoting good governance & ensuring transparency in the use of public funds. It will also enable the SAI to communicate to the local governments the importance of preparing timely financial statements and to clarify the role of the SAI in promoting the local government accountability. Although the legal framework of the SAI is now established, the SAI is still not able to fully execute its mandate due to shortage of human and material resources. In its mandate, the SAI is expected to carry out teh audit of state accounts and budget execution reporting, carry out the audit of the accounts prepared by the local governments and the audit of state owned entreprises as well as all institutions in which the state has a financial interest. The objective of this IDF grant, therefore, is to strengthen the capacity of the SAI to enable it to carry out its mandate of first, auditing and reviewing state accounts, local government accounts and those of state owned enterprises in a timely manner. And secondly, of ensuring transparency in the use of public funds, by regularly publishing up to date reports in its website where they will be easily accessible to the general public. Overall, the capacity building of the SAI will significantly contribute to good governance.
